svg.title: The next experiment in four moves, plus data and code sources.

section.div: The next experiment, in four moves

div.div: Rate while listeningA continuous slider so the EEG can be aligned with moments of feeling, not whole songs.
Zoom in on peaksTime resolved analyses of the seconds around a climax, a chord change, a voice entering.
More songs per personSharper personal slopes, and a real chance to learn whether people truly differ.
Truly unpleasant musicA wider valence range, with the song and self split reused to keep the two apart.

footer.span: Models: linear mixed models (lme4), Bonferroni α = .025 for H1 and H2
Code, preregistration and figures: GitHub account Koundinya2003
